newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX up on correction, cold weather.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX up on correction, cold weather.

text.p: Crude futures in Asia were indicated firmer on technical correction after plunging 21 cents on Friday in London, brokers said on Monday.
February Brent futures was quoted at $24.45/$24.80, up slightly from its last close on London's IPE at $24.34.
Brokers said they expect levels to climb, correcting from London close.
They said the cold weather in the U.S northeast and Europe would continue to support the market.
NYMEX February contract was last traded at $26.41, up 32 cents from its last official close of $26.09, supported by the cold temperatures, brokers said.
